Failure mode / cause: CF1 Loss of balance while reaching, carrying tools or parts, or working on a curved surface
Effect: Maintainer falls from the walker or the access equipment

Failure mode / cause: CF2 No access platform or anchor point; ladder or stand not secured to the walker or the ground
Effect: Maintainer falls from the walker or the access equipment

Failure mode / cause: CF3 Wet, oily or icy surfaces; wind; poor lighting in the maintenance area
Effect: Maintainer falls from the walker or the access equipment

Failure mode / cause: CF1 Accumulator or trapped volume not vented by isolation
Effect: Sudden limb movement; high-pressure fluid release

Failure mode / cause: CF2 Maintainer skips isolation or verification step
Effect: Sudden limb movement; high-pressure fluid release

Failure mode / cause: CF1 Fuel line, fitting or tank failure from vibration or a fall (SCN-103)
Effect: Fuel fire on the walker; burning fuel on the ground around it

Failure mode / cause: CF2 Refuelling with the engine hot or running, or near an ignition source
Effect: Fuel fire on the walker; burning fuel on the ground around it

Failure mode / cause: CF3 Exhaust or engine surface hotter than the fuel's autoignition temperature next to a leak path
Effect: Fuel fire on the walker; burning fuel on the ground around it
